name: rosetta-compiler-virtual-machine-interpreter
code:
use default

use System.BitConverter
use System.StringSplitOptions

enum Op is
    FETCH, STORE, PUSH,
    ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV, MOD,
    LT, GT, LE, GE, EQ, NE, AND, OR,
    NEG, NOT, JMP, JZ,
    PRTC, PRTS, PRTI, HALT
si

class MACHINE is
    _code: ubyte[]
    _strings: List[string]
    _data: LIST[int]
    _stack: LIST[int]
    _pc: int

    init(code: ubyte[], strings: List[string], data_size: int) is
        _code = code
        _strings = strings
        _data = repeat(0, data_size) |> collect_list()
        _stack = LIST[int]()
    si

    run() is
        do
            let op = cast Op(cast int(_code[_pc]))

            _pc = _pc + 1

            case op
            when Op.FETCH then _push(_data[_operand()])
            when Op.STORE then _data[_operand()] = _pop()
            when Op.PUSH then _push(_operand())
            when Op.JMP then _pc = _pc + _offset()
            when Op.JZ then
                let offset = _offset()

                _pc = _pc + if _pop() == 0 then offset else 4 fi
            when Op.NEG then _push(-_pop())
            when Op.NOT then _push(truth(_pop() == 0))
            when Op.PRTC then IO.Std.write(cast char(_pop()))
            when Op.PRTS then IO.Std.write(_strings[_pop()])
            when Op.PRTI then IO.Std.write("{_pop()}")
            when Op.HALT then break
            else
                let b = _pop()
                let a = _pop()

                _push(_binary(op, a, b))
            esac
        od
    si

    _binary(op: Op, a: int, b: int) -> int =>
        case op
        when Op.ADD then a + b
        when Op.SUB then a - b
        when Op.MUL then a * b
        when Op.DIV then a / b
        when Op.MOD then a % b
        when Op.LT then truth(a < b)
        when Op.GT then truth(a > b)
        when Op.LE then truth(a <= b)
        when Op.GE then truth(a >= b)
        when Op.EQ then truth(a == b)
        when Op.NE then truth(a != b)
        when Op.AND then truth(a != 0 /\ b != 0)
        when Op.OR then truth(a != 0 \/ b != 0)
        else throw System.Exception("not a binary operator: {op}")
        esac

    _offset() -> int => BitConverter.to_int32(_code, _pc)

    _operand() -> int is
        let value = _offset()

        _pc = _pc + 4

        value
    si

    _push(value: int) is
        _stack.add(value)
    si

    _pop() -> int is
        let value = _stack[_stack.count - 1]

        _stack.remove_at(_stack.count - 1)

        value
    si
si

truth(value: bool) -> int => if value then 1 else 0 fi

unquote(text: string) -> string =>
    text[1..<1].replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\\\", "\\")

let lines = LIST[string]()

while let line = IO.Std.read_line() do
    lines.add(line)
od

let header = lines[0].split([' '])
let data_size = int.parse(header[1])
let string_count = int.parse(header[3])

let strings = lines |> skip(1) |> take(string_count) |> map(unquote)
let code = LIST[ubyte]()

for line in lines |> skip(1 + string_count) do
    let parts = line.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

    assert int.parse(parts[0]) == code.count
    else "address {parts[0]} out of step"

    let op = System.Enum.parse[Op](parts[1].to_upper_invariant())

    code.add(cast ubyte(cast int(op)))

    if parts.count > 2 then
        let operand = int.parse(parts[2].trim(['[', ']', '(', ')']))

        code.add_range(BitConverter.get_bytes(operand))
    fi
od

MACHINE(code.to_array(), strings |> collect_list(), data_size).run()
